The '''Darlyn Boda system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Anoat sector/Legends|Anoat sector]] of the [[Greater Javin/Legends|Greater Javin]] region of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Darlyn Boda/Legends|Darlyn Boda]] was located within the system.
